design: Compact wiry record keeper with a narrow peaked crown, small angular four mandibles and thin mid-length dreadlocks bundled over right shoulder. Shorter knee-length archive tunic under an open long black scholar wrap, a grid of eight small thin record pockets across one side of chest. Right hand draws one flat record strip from a pocket while left supports a closed narrow folio. Tan olive scales.
